population: All 200 p_core original English questions, ids 0-199; no attack-success or heatmap-finiteness filter applied to length audit.

counting_definitions.characters_including_spaces: Python len of original string, including punctuation and spaces.
counting_definitions.whitespace_word_count: len(question.split()), punctuation attached to a word remains part of that whitespace token.
counting_definitions.lexical_word_count: Regex [A-Za-z]+(?:['’][A-Za-z]+)*|[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)*; contractions/possessives counted as one lexical token; punctuation excluded; digits count as a lexical token.
counting_definitions.question_subtoken_count: Exact length of provided qmask question-subtoken sequence; no prompt/template/system tokens.
counting_definitions.syntactic_complexity: Not inferred from any numerical length threshold.

manual_structure_audit.method: Manual review of all 200 original question strings; no parser, token-count threshold, or punctuation-count proxy used to classify syntactic complexity.
manual_structure_audit.scope_of_claim: No explicit coordinate/subordinate multi-finite-clause question or multi-sentence paragraph was identified. This is a descriptive manual audit, not a full gold syntactic parse or a claim that every item has only one possible clause under all grammars.

nonfinite_or_embedded_structure_examples.question: What are these people preparing to do?
nonfinite_or_embedded_structure_examples.analysis: preparing to do contains a nonfinite infinitival complement; the question still has one finite main clause.

nonfinite_or_embedded_structure_examples.question: Which hand is the child using to eat with?
nonfinite_or_embedded_structure_examples.analysis: using to eat with contains a nonfinite infinitival purpose/complement structure; exact attachment can be analyzed differently.

nonfinite_or_embedded_structure_examples.question: Who is the guy playing tennis?
nonfinite_or_embedded_structure_examples.analysis: playing tennis can be read as a nonfinite/reduced-relative modifier of the guy; the sentence is structurally ambiguous without context.

nonfinite_or_embedded_structure_examples.question: What tool is being used for cutting?
nonfinite_or_embedded_structure_examples.analysis: for cutting contains a gerund, analyzable as nominalized activity or a nonfinite clause depending on grammatical framework; do not silently count it as an additional finite clause.

do_not_misclassify_examples.reason: Longest by word count, but nested of-phrases and passive be seen do not constitute several finite clauses.
Longest by subtoken count is partly driven by fragmented proper names; subtoken length is not syntactic complexity.
In addition to clouds is a prepositional phrase; its comma does not establish an additional clause.
Final ?? is repeated punctuation within one question, not two sentences.
What is this person have ... is malformed; extra verb forms should not automatically be interpreted as a multi-clause construction.
How many men bicycling? has an omitted auxiliary/elliptical construction, not evidence of a long complex passage.

manual_structure_audit.generalization: This corpus cannot establish behavior on long sentences, multi-sentence paragraphs, or systematic interactions among negation, scope, instructions, anaphora and several clauses.
